newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker slips $1-$2/T, enquiries thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker slips $1-$2/T, enquiries thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes slipped further on thin demand and softer crude prices, traders said on Tuesday.

"The market is very thin," said one trader. Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at $96, down by $2 per tonne. Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $103-$105 per tonne by most majors with independents at $99-$100.
"The market outside Singapore is better," said one major, citing more enquiries in the European markets.
MDO was indicated at $195 and gas oil at $210.
